name: supertool
description: Batched file operations for autonomous Claude Code runs. Collapses N reads/greps/globs into one Bash round-trip. Includes session-start prompt injection and a PreToolUse guard that refuses raw shell commands an op replaces, plus a small shipped rule layer for what `replaces` cannot express (hooks/guard-selftest.py lists it). Blocking the harness's own file tools is the operator's setting, not the plugin's (README, Hard-block native tools).
